mentions.name: Rita
mentions.description: This iOS app is an ADHD medication companion that helps with remembering to take meds, understanding the medication's effect curve, and receiving lifecycle notifications for when it peaks or starts to wear off. It supports pacing multiple doses throughout the day and managing medication supply. Health data is stored in the user's own private iCloud account, with no access by the developers.
mentions.problem: Remembering to take ADHD medication, understanding effect timing, pacing doses throughout the day, and managing supply.
